column7: Accepting a pending project-scoped invitation (or a global invite's project assignments) granted the role from a suspended inviter's authority: the account-state check sat on the exported InviteMember, while accept-time grants call inviteMemberWithMode directly. requireInviterActive now refuses before the account is created and again in applyInvitationGrants. Found by the SUPERFAN-1118 critical-path review of #4336
